Title: Organization roles whitelist filters the org-level 'Change roles' select2 picker (CONFIRMED WORKING -- verify via removal, not addition)
Section: Org Roles > Organization Whitelist > Dropdown Filter
Preconditions: Admin logged into {{BACK_URL}}. VCST-5239 (customer#304) ships Customer|Roles settings Customer.OrganizationRolesWhitelist / Customer.MembershipRolesWhitelist (ValueType=ShortText, IsDictionary=true; whitelist content lives in allowedValues, NOT value). Whitelist entries are SELECTED from the live platform roles list (GET /api/platform/security/roles/search) -- never free-text dictionary entry. VERIFIED LIVE (2026-07-09, live re-verification corrected a stale earlier read): the org-level 'Change roles' role picker DOES filter by the Organization whitelist. Picker options = (assignable roles INTERSECT whitelist) MINUS roles already assigned to that org -- so testing by ADDING a whitelisted role to an org with none yet assigned looks unfiltered (nothing to subtract) and is further confounded by the VCST-5441 clear-persist bug (ORGROLE-005). The CORRECT falsification is to REMOVE a role that is CURRENTLY VISIBLE in the picker from the whitelist and confirm it disappears. The picker is a select2 control -- open and read it via CDP (Chrome DevTools MCP); a synthetic click that never dispatches a real pointer event into the select2 search area will fail to open the dropdown and produce a false 'unfiltered/all roles' read (this is what produced the earlier incorrect DRAFT/FAIL status on this case). Settings changes require a cache-reset + full page reload (ignoreCache navigation, not an in-SPA route change) before the picker reflects them. A throwaway AGENT-TEST organization is created in Steps so the shared TechFlow/BuildRight fixtures are never touched.

Title: organization.contacts(roleIds:) filters by the EFFECTIVE role set (org-inherited roles included, not membership-only); omitted/empty roleIds returns the unfiltered list
Section: Org Roles > Contacts Role Filter > AC8
Preconditions: Runner-native. Closes testing-checklist.md AC8 (GAP -- no prior case exercised `organization.contacts(roleIds:)` at the backend/schema layer; `B2C-MBR-025` in `008-b2b-members.csv` only exercises the storefront CONSUMER of this filter). Field/arg confirmed by LIVE introspection 2026-07-09: `Organization.contacts(after, first, searchPhrase, sort, roleIds: [String])`. LIVE-VERIFIED 2026-07-09 end-to-end on a throwaway org+member: (1) filtering by the member's DIRECT membership role returns them: totalCount 1; (2) filtering by an ORG-LEVEL role the org carries (which this member does NOT hold individually, only via inheritance) ALSO returns them: totalCount 1 -- `contacts(roleIds:)` reflects the UNION/effective role set, not membership-only (BL-B2B-005), which also grounds ORGROLE-017's technique; (3) filtering by a role nobody holds returns totalCount 0; (4) omitting `roleIds` returns the full unfiltered list; (5) `roleIds: []` (empty array) ALSO returns the full unfiltered list, NOT zero -- confirms no accidental empty-set-matches-none semantics (the exact concern testing-checklist.md AC8 flags). Steps below include that link step; omitting it would make this case falsely read as 'contacts returns nothing at all', not a filter-correctness result.
